evidence.text: An 80% win rate system can slowly bleed you to death if every loss is 10× larger than wins. The win rate alone is meaningless without expectancy . This is the most common misunderstanding in Indian retail trading. 🇮🇳 // RAHUL BHAI'S "LOSING" SYSTEM THAT ACTUALLY PRINTS MONEY Rahul bhai wins only 4 out of 10 Nifty options trades . His friends mock him constantly — "Tu toh hamesha lose karta hai!" But: Each win = ₹4,000 . Each loss = ₹900 . E = (40% × ₹4,000) − (60% × ₹900) = ₹1,600 − ₹540 = ₹1,06

evidence.text: An 80% win rate system can slowly bleed you to death if every loss is 10× larger than wins. The win rate alone is meaningless without expectancy .
